In the present study, we used multiple clones of the previously generated AC-iPSCs (clones #7, #14, and # 15), and compared their pluripotency, progenitor properties, and chondrogenic potential to that of newly generated OA-derived iPSCs (OA-iPSCs) (clones #2, #5, and #8) (Figure 1A).
